There are 12 Zodiacs in the night sky. Legends say there use to be more.
Corellon is the god of magic and the arts. Some say that magic is an art.
Ioun is the goddess of knowledge. Seeminly a passive goddess these days, some even question if shes abandoned us.
Sehanine is the goddess of the moon. Known patron of trickery and illusions, but is also worshiped as the goddess of love.
Lolth the spider queen, is the goddess of secrets and lies. Rumors say she's trying to steal the Weave for herself.
Elven ritual magic is based on a sense of inner focus. A deeper connection with the Weave as it connects with the world around you to empower spells.

Legends have it that the original Deck of Fate was a gift from a Trickster God, bestowed to their followers in return for a great service. Scholars of such things believe that once the last of its magic is used, the Deck reforms somewhere else in the world, hidden away in dark corners or forgotten treasure hoards for the unwary to discover.
Don't forget you can harvest crafting parts and essence for enchanting from creatures you slay!
The Festival of the Falling Stars happens on the first day of the new moon in the month of Kythorn.
Wild Magic zones form near places where the Weave has been frayed, warped, or destroyed.
Crying is always a free action.
